en.summary: A highway collision in Kenya killed seventeen people, predominantly Catholic pilgrims, after a truck driver's failed overtaking attempt caused a crash involving a van carrying the pilgrims.

en.title: Archie Owen Claims first F4 victory as Aramco F4 Saudi Arabian Championship opens at Jeddah Corniche Circuit
